title: The pitch, the reviews and the goodbye
lede: Ouya was sold on video before it existed. These are the campaign film and a later commercial from the company’s own channel, two reviews from 2013, a conference talk by the founder and a news item from the day she left. Dates are upload dates unless the caption says otherwise.

videos.title: The official Ouya Kickstarter video
videos.caption: The three-minute film from the campaign page, as posted on the company’s own YouTube channel on August 29, 2012, after the campaign had closed with $8,596,474.[^36][^1]

videos.title: The Verge: “Ouya hands-on review”
videos.caption: Published by The Verge on April 4, 2013 with its written review of the backers’ console, which scored 3.5 out of 10.[^7]

videos.title: IGN Reviews: Ouya
videos.caption: IGN’s video review of the retail console, published July 26, 2013, a month after it reached stores. Its verdict is IGN’s; we cite no figure from it.

videos.title: Julie Uhrman at XOXO Festival
videos.caption: A 19-minute talk by the founder, posted by the festival on October 18, 2013, a few weeks after the Free the Games Fund was rewritten.[^17] It is her account, not a source for any figure on this page.

videos.title: “OUYA – TV Commercial”
videos.caption: A 31-second spot uploaded to the company’s channel on February 25, 2014 under that title.[^36] Where and when it aired on television is not in our sources.

videos.title: IGN News: “Ouya CEO Leaves Company Following Razer Acquisition”
videos.caption: A one-minute news item published July 27, 2015, the day Razer confirmed the purchase and Uhrman announced her departure.[^25][^26]

note: We found no embeddable footage of the June 25, 2019 shutdown itself from a news organisation.
